```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7,
  dpi = 300

```

```{r libraries}
pacman::p_load(dplyr, here, tidyverse, lubridate, sf, 
               rnaturalearth, rnaturalearthdata, viridis, 
               ggspatial, knitr, kableExtra, patchwork,
               igraph, ggraph, tidygraph)
```

```{r load-data}
LV_ARC          <- readRDS(here("OUTPUT/LV_ARC_encounters.rds"))
LV_ARC_reliable <- readRDS(here("OUTPUT/LV_ARC_reliable2.rds"))
quality_ids     <- readRDS(here("OUTPUT/quality_ids_arctic2.rds"))
sightings       <- readRDS(here("OUTPUT/sightings_arctic2.rds"))

resights_file <- here("OUTPUT/resights_categorized.rds")
if (file.exists(resights_file)) {
  resights <- readRDS(resights_file)
  has_resights <- TRUE
} else {
  has_resights <- FALSE
}

assoc_file <- here("OUTPUT/association_frequency.csv")
if (file.exists(assoc_file)) {
  associations <- read_csv(assoc_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(ID_side1, "^(ASO|LAB)"),
           !str_detect(ID_side2, "^(ASO|LAB)"))
  has_associations <- TRUE
} else {
  has_associations <- FALSE
}
```

---

# Key Findings

```{r key-findings}
# Left / Right ID counts
n_left  <- n_distinct(LV_ARC$ID_side[LV_ARC$side == "Left"])
n_right <- n_distinct(LV_ARC$ID_side[LV_ARC$side == "Right"])
n_base  <- n_distinct(LV_ARC$ID)

# Multi-year IDs by side
multi_year_left  <- sum(quality_ids$n_years > 1 & quality_ids$side == "Left",  na.rm = TRUE)
multi_year_right <- sum(quality_ids$n_years > 1 & quality_ids$side == "Right", na.rm = TRUE)

# Resight counts by side (if available)
if (has_resights) {
  n_resight_left  <- n_distinct(resights$ID_side[resights$side == "Left"])
  n_resight_right <- n_distinct(resights$ID_side[resights$side == "Right"])
  n_byyear_left   <- n_distinct(resights$ID_side[!resights$same_year & resights$side == "Left"])
  n_byyear_right  <- n_distinct(resights$ID_side[!resights$same_year & resights$side == "Right"])
} else {
  n_resight_left <- n_resight_right <- n_byyear_left <- n_byyear_right <- NA
}

findings <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Left-side IDs (3*+ quality photos)",
    "Right-side IDs (3*+ quality photos)",
    "Unique base IDs (combined sides)",
    "Left-side IDs seen in multiple years",
    "Right-side IDs seen in multiple years",
    "Years covered",
    "Photos with GPS",
    "Left-side IDs with any resight",
    "Right-side IDs with any resight",
    "Left-side IDs with between-year resights",
    "Right-side IDs with between-year resights"
  ),
  Value = c(
    format(n_left,  big.mark = ","),
    format(n_right, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_base,  big.mark = ","),
    format(multi_year_left,  big.mark = ","),
    format(multi_year_right, big.mark = ","),
    paste(min(LV_ARC$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(LV_ARC$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE)),
    paste0(format(sum(!is.na(LV_ARC$Latitude)), big.mark = ","), " (",
           round(100 * sum(!is.na(LV_ARC$Latitude)) / nrow(LV_ARC), 1), "%)"),
    ifelse(is.na(n_resight_left),  "N/A", format(n_resight_left,  big.mark = ",")),
    ifelse(is.na(n_resight_right), "N/A", format(n_resight_right, big.mark = ",")),
    ifelse(is.na(n_byyear_left),   "N/A", format(n_byyear_left,   big.mark = ",")),
    ifelse(is.na(n_byyear_right),  "N/A", format(n_byyear_right,  big.mark = ","))
  )
)

kable(findings, caption = "Key Catalogue Findings (Left and Right sides reported separately)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(c(1, 4, 8, 10), background = "#e8f4f8") %>%  # highlight Left rows
  row_spec(c(2, 5, 9, 11), background = "#fef9e7")       # highlight Right rows
```

# Dataset Summary

## Photos and IDs by Dataset

```{r dataset-breakdown}
dataset_summary <- LV_ARC %>%
  group_by(Dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Photos    = n(),
    Left_Sides  = n_distinct(ID_side[side == "Left"]),
    Right_Sides = n_distinct(ID_side[side == "Right"]),
    Max_Year    = max(YEAR),
    Years       = if_else(min(YEAR) == max(YEAR),
                          as.character(min(YEAR)),
                          paste(min(YEAR), max(YEAR), sep = "-")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Note = case_when(
      grepl("200[3-9]|201[0-6]", Years) ~ "Not included in maps/analyses",
      TRUE ~ "On Pamiut, Tarajoq, or other Fishing Vessel"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Max_Year)) %>%
  select(-Max_Year)

kable(dataset_summary,
      caption = "Photos and IDs by Dataset (only 2017+ data used in maps/analyses)",
      col.names = c("Dataset", "Photos", "Left-Sides", "Right-Sides", "Years", "Note")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

## IDs and % Reliable by Year

```{r quality-by-year}
# 3*+ IDs by year and side
quality_ids_by_year <- LV_ARC %>%
  filter(QRATE >= 3) %>%
  group_by(YEAR, side) %>%
  summarise(
    n_unique_ids = n_distinct(ID_side),
    n_photos     = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(side %in% c("Left", "Right")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = side,
    values_from = c(n_unique_ids, n_photos),
    names_glue  = "{side}_{.value}"
  )

# Percent reliable (Reliable == "Yes") per year
reliable_by_year <- LV_ARC %>%
  filter(QRATE >= 3) %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total    = n_distinct(ID_side),
    n_reliable = n_distinct(ID_side[Reliable == "Yes"]),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pct_reliable = round(100 * n_reliable / n_total, 1))

quality_by_year <- quality_ids_by_year %>%
  left_join(reliable_by_year %>% select(YEAR, n_reliable, pct_reliable),
            by = "YEAR") %>%
  arrange(YEAR)

kable(quality_by_year,
      caption = "3*+ Quality IDs and Reliable IDs by Year",
      col.names = c("Year", "Left IDs", "Left Photos",
                    "Right IDs", "Right Photos",
                    "Reliable IDs", "% Reliable")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

```{r top-ids}
top_ids <- quality_ids %>%
```

# Resighting Analysis

```{r resight-check, results='asis'}
if (!has_resights) {
  cat("No resighting data available.\n\n")
}
```

```{r resight-summary, results='asis', eval=has_resights}
# Summary counts by side -- used inline below
left_resights  <- resights %>% filter(side == "Left")
right_resights <- resights %>% filter(side == "Right")

resight_breakdown <- resights %>%
  mutate(resight_category = case_when(
    resight_type == "Within_Day"               ~ "Within_Day",
    same_year & days_diff >= 1  & days_diff < 7   ~ "Within_Year_Days",
    same_year & days_diff >= 7  & days_diff < 365  ~ "Within_Year_Weeks",
    !same_year                                 ~ "Between_Years",
    TRUE                                       ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  group_by(side, resight_category) %>%
  summarise(n_pairs = n(), n_ids = n_distinct(ID_side), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(side, resight_category)

kable(resight_breakdown,
      caption = "Resight Pairs by Category and Side",
      col.names = c("Side", "Category", "Pairs", "Unique IDs")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## Within-Day Resights

```{r within-day-resights, eval=has_resights}
within_day <- resights %>%
  filter(resight_type == "Within_Day") %>%
  arrange(ID_side, sighting1_date, time_diff_hours) %>%
  mutate(GPS_Status = case_when(
    both_have_gps                              ~ "Both",
    sighting1_has_gps & !sighting2_has_gps    ~ "First only",
    !sighting1_has_gps & sighting2_has_gps    ~ "Second only",
    TRUE                                       ~ "Neither"
  )) %>%
  select(ID_side, side, sighting1_date, time_diff_hours, distance_km, GPS_Status)

if (nrow(within_day) > 0) {
  cat("Total within-day resights:", nrow(within_day), "\n")
  cat("Average time between encounters:",
      round(mean(within_day$time_diff_hours, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "hours\n\n")

  # Top 10 per side
  top_within <- within_day %>%
    group_by(side) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = time_diff_hours, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  kable(top_within,
        caption = "Top 10 Within-Day Resights per Side (longest gap first).",
        col.names = c("ID", "Side", "Date", "Time Diff (hrs)", "Distance (km)", "GPS Status"),
        digits = 2) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
} else {
  cat("No within-day resights found\n")
}
```

## Within-Year Multiple-Day Resights

Same individual seen on different days within the same calendar year
(days_diff 1 to 6 -- i.e. different days but less than one week apart).

```{r between-day-resights, eval=has_resights}
# Within same year, different days, less than one week apart
between_days <- resights %>%
  filter(same_year == TRUE, days_diff >= 1, days_diff < 7) %>%
  arrange(ID_side, sighting1_date, days_diff) %>%
  mutate(GPS_Status = case_when(
    both_have_gps                            ~ "Both",
    sighting1_has_gps & !sighting2_has_gps  ~ "First only",
    !sighting1_has_gps & sighting2_has_gps  ~ "Second only",
    TRUE                                     ~ "Neither"
  )) %>%
  select(ID_side, side, sighting1_date, sighting2_date,
         days_diff, distance_km, GPS_Status)

if (nrow(between_days) > 0) {
  cat("Total within-year day-scale resights (1-6 days):", nrow(between_days), "\n")
  cat("Average gap:", round(mean(between_days$days_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "days\n\n")

  top_between <- between_days %>%
    group_by(side) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = days_diff, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  kable(top_between,
        caption = "Top 10 Within-Year Day-Scale Resights per Side (longest gap first).",
        col.names = c("ID", "Side", "First", "Second",
                      "Days", "Distance (km)", "GPS Status"),
        digits = 2) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
} else {
  cat("No within-year day-scale resights found\n")
}
```

## Within-Year Week-Scale Resights

Same individual seen on different occasions within the same calendar year,
at least one week apart (days_diff 7 to 364).

```{r between-week-resights, eval=has_resights}
between_weeks <- resights %>%
  filter(same_year == TRUE, days_diff >= 7, days_diff < 365) %>%
  arrange(ID_side, sighting1_date, days_diff) %>%
  mutate(
    weeks_diff = round(days_diff / 7, 1),
    GPS_Status = case_when(
      both_have_gps                            ~ "Both",
      sighting1_has_gps & !sighting2_has_gps  ~ "First only",
      !sighting1_has_gps & sighting2_has_gps  ~ "Second only",
      TRUE                                     ~ "Neither"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(ID_side, side, sighting1_date, sighting2_date,
         weeks_diff, days_diff, distance_km, GPS_Status)

if (nrow(between_weeks) > 0) {
  cat("Total within-year week-scale resights (7-364 days):", nrow(between_weeks), "\n")
  cat("Average gap:", round(mean(between_weeks$weeks_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "weeks\n\n")

  top_weeks <- between_weeks %>%
    group_by(side) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = days_diff, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  kable(top_weeks,
        caption = "Top 10 Within-Year Week-Scale Resights per Side (longest gap first). ",
        col.names = c("ID", "Side", "First", "Second",
                      "Weeks", "Days", "Distance (km)", "GPS Status"),
        digits = 2) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
} else {
  cat("No within-year week-scale resights found\n")
}
```

## Between-Year Resights

```{r between-year-resights, eval=has_resights}
between_years <- resights %>%
  filter(!same_year) %>%
  mutate(
    years_between = year(sighting2_date) - year(sighting1_date),
    GPS_Status = case_when(
      both_have_gps                            ~ "Both",
      sighting1_has_gps & !sighting2_has_gps  ~ "First only",
      !sighting1_has_gps & sighting2_has_gps  ~ "Second only",
      TRUE                                     ~ "Neither"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(ID_side, sighting1_date) %>%
  select(ID_side, side, sighting1_date, sighting2_date,
         years_between, days_diff, distance_km, GPS_Status)

if (nrow(between_years) > 0) {
  cat("Total between-year resights:", nrow(between_years), "\n")
  cat("IDs with between-year resights:", n_distinct(between_years$ID_side), "\n")
  cat("  Left: ", n_distinct(between_years$ID_side[between_years$side == "Left"]), "\n")
  cat("  Right:", n_distinct(between_years$ID_side[between_years$side == "Right"]), "\n\n")

  top_by <- between_years %>%
    group_by(side) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = years_between, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  kable(top_by,
        caption = "Top 10 Between-Year Resights per Side (longest gap first). ",
        col.names = c("ID", "Side", "First", "Second",
                      "Years", "Days", "Distance (km)", "GPS Status"),
        digits = 2) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
} else {
  cat("No between-year resights found\n")
}
```

## Resight Time Distribution

```{r resight-time-dist, eval=has_resights, fig.cap="Distribution of time between resightings by side"}
if (has_resights && sum(resights$days_diff >= 1) > 0) {
  resights %>%
    filter(days_diff >= 1) %>%
    mutate(time_category = case_when(
      same_year & days_diff < 7   ~ "Same year\n< 1 week",
      same_year & days_diff < 365 ~ "Same year\n1+ weeks",
      !same_year                  ~ "Between years"
    ),
    time_category = factor(time_category,
                           levels = c("Same year\n< 1 week",
                                      "Same year\n1+ weeks",
                                      "Between years"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time_category, fill = time_category)) +
    geom_bar() +
    facet_wrap(~side) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", begin = 0.2, end = 0.85) +
    labs(title = "Time Between Resightings by Side",
         x = "Resight Category", y = "Number of Resight Pairs") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 10, hjust = 1))
}
```

# Social Associations - Encounter Level

```{r associations-check, results='asis'}
if (!has_associations) {
  cat("No association data available.\n")
}
```

```{r association-networks, eval=has_associations, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
if (has_associations && nrow(associations) > 0) {
  cat("Total unique ID-side pairs seen together:", nrow(associations), "\n")
  cat("Total encounters together:", sum(associations$n_encounters_together), "\n")
  cat("Pairs seen together in multiple encounters:",
      sum(associations$n_encounters_together > 1), "\n\n")

  side_summary <- associations %>%
    group_by(side_combo) %>%
    summarise(n_pairs = n(),
              total_encounters = sum(n_encounters_together),
              .groups = "drop")
  print(side_summary)

  # LEFT-LEFT
  left_assoc <- associations %>% filter(side_combo == "Left")
  if (nrow(left_assoc) > 0) {
    edges_left     <- left_assoc %>% select(from = ID_side1, to = ID_side2, weight = n_encounters_together)
    node_data_left <- quality_ids %>%
      filter(ID_side %in% c(edges_left$from, edges_left$to)) %>%
      select(ID_side, n_encounters)
    g_left      <- graph_from_data_frame(edges_left, directed = FALSE, vertices = node_data_left)
    tidy_g_left <- as_tbl_graph(g_left)
    set.seed(42)
    print(
      ggraph(tidy_g_left, layout = "fr") +
        geom_edge_link(aes(width = weight, alpha = weight), color = "#2c7bb6") +
        geom_node_point(aes(size = n_encounters), color = "#d7191c", alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_node_text(aes(label = name), size = 2.5, repel = TRUE,
                       max.overlaps = 20, segment.color = "grey80", segment.size = 0.2) +
        scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 3), name = "Encounters\nTogether") +
        scale_edge_alpha(range = c(0.3, 0.8), guide = "none") +
        scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10), name = "Total\nEncounters") +
        labs(title = "Left-Side Associations (3*+ Quality IDs)",
             subtitle = paste(nrow(left_assoc), "left-side pairs seen together")) +
        theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
              legend.position = "right")
    )
  }

  # RIGHT-RIGHT
  right_assoc <- associations %>% filter(side_combo == "Right")
  if (nrow(right_assoc) > 0) {
    edges_right     <- right_assoc %>% select(from = ID_side1, to = ID_side2, weight = n_encounters_together)
    node_data_right <- quality_ids %>%
      filter(ID_side %in% c(edges_right$from, edges_right$to)) %>%
      select(ID_side, n_encounters)
    g_right      <- graph_from_data_frame(edges_right, directed = FALSE, vertices = node_data_right)
    tidy_g_right <- as_tbl_graph(g_right)
    set.seed(43)
    print(
      ggraph(tidy_g_right, layout = "fr") +
        geom_edge_link(aes(width = weight, alpha = weight), color = "#2c7bb6") +
        geom_node_point(aes(size = n_encounters), color = "#d7191c", alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_node_text(aes(label = name), size = 2.5, repel = TRUE,
                       max.overlaps = 20, segment.color = "grey80", segment.size = 0.2) +
        scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 3), name = "Encounters\nTogether") +
        scale_edge_alpha(range = c(0.3, 0.8), guide = "none") +
        scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10), name = "Total\nEncounters") +
        labs(title = "Right-Side Associations (3*+ Quality IDs)",
             subtitle = paste(nrow(right_assoc), "right-side pairs seen together")) +
        theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
              legend.position = "right")
    )
  }

  # L-R pairs reference table
  lr_encounters <- associations %>%
    filter(side_combo == "Left-Right") %>%
    arrange(desc(n_encounters_together))

  if (nrow(lr_encounters) > 0) {
    cat("\n### Reference: Left-Right Encounter Pairs\n\n")
    cat(nrow(lr_encounters),
        "pairs photographed from different sides in the same encounter.\n\n")
    print(head(lr_encounters %>%
                 select(ID_side1, ID_side2, n_encounters_together, dates), 10))
  }
}
```

# Spatial Analysis

```{r map-prep}
world   <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

LV_ARC_sf <- LV_ARC %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Longitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

bbox   <- st_bbox(LV_ARC_sf)
buffer <- 2
xlims  <- c(bbox["xmin"] - buffer, bbox["xmax"] + buffer)
ylims  <- c(bbox["ymin"] - buffer, bbox["ymax"] + buffer)
```

## All Sightings (2017+)

```{r all-sightings-map, fig.cap="All sightings 2017+", fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
year_colors <- c("2017" = "#e41a1c", "2018" = "#377eb8", "2019" = "#4daf4a",
                  "2021" = "#ff7f00", "2022" = "darkblue",
                 "2023" = "#a65628", "2024" = "#f781bf")

LV_reliable_sf <- LV_ARC_reliable %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Longitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#e0e0e0", color = "#666666", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = st_jitter(LV_reliable_sf, factor = 0.005),
          aes(color = as.factor(YEAR)), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = year_colors, na.value = "gray50") +
  coord_sf(xlim = xlims, ylim = ylims, crs = 4326) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tl", which_north = "true",
                         style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering()) +
  labs(title = "Arctic Northern Bottlenose Whale Photo-ID Locations",
       subtitle = "Sightings 2017-2024", color = "Year") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
        legend.position = "right")
```

## Sightings by Year

```{r sightings-by-year-maps, fig.cap="Sightings by year", fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
if (nrow(LV_reliable_sf) > 0) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#e0e0e0", color = "#666666", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = st_jitter(LV_reliable_sf, factor = 0.005),
            aes(color = as.factor(YEAR)), alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~factor(YEAR, levels = sort(unique(YEAR), decreasing = TRUE)), ncol = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = year_colors) +
    coord_sf(xlim = xlims, ylim = ylims, crs = 4326) +
    labs(title = "Sightings by Year (2017-2024)", color = "Year") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
          legend.position = "none",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
}
```

## Resight Locations

```{r resight-map, eval=has_resights, fig.cap="Locations of ID resightings", fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
if (has_resights && sum(!is.na(resights$distance_km)) > 0) {
  resight_locations <- resights %>%
    filter(!is.na(distance_km), sighting1_date >= "2017-01-01") %>%
    select(ID_side, ID, side, sighting1_date, sighting2_date, resight_type) %>%
    inner_join(sightings %>% select(ID_side, Date, Latitude, Longitude, start_time),
               by = c("ID_side", "sighting1_date" = "Date")) %>%
    rename(Lat1 = Latitude, Lon1 = Longitude) %>%
    inner_join(sightings %>% select(ID_side, Date, Latitude, Longitude, start_time),
               by = c("ID_side", "sighting2_date" = "Date"),
               suffix = c("", ".2")) %>%
    rename(Lat2 = Latitude, Lon2 = Longitude) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Lat1), !is.na(Lat2))

  if (nrow(resight_locations) > 0) {
    resight_lines <- resight_locations %>%
      mutate(resight_type = factor(resight_type,
                                   levels = c("Within_Day", "Within_Month",
                                              "Within_Year", "Between_Years"))) %>%
      arrange(resight_type) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(geometry = st_sfc(
        st_linestring(matrix(c(Lon1, Lat1, Lon2, Lat2), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)),
        crs = 4326)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      st_as_sf()

    resight_points <- bind_rows(
      resight_locations %>% select(ID_side, Lat = Lat1, Lon = Lon1, resight_type),
      resight_locations %>% select(ID_side, Lat = Lat2, Lon = Lon2, resight_type)
    ) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      st_as_sf(coords = c("Lon", "Lat"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

    resight_colors <- c("Within_Day" = "black", "Within_Month" = "#d95f02",
                        "Within_Year" = "#7570b3", "Between_Years" = "#e7298a")

    ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#e0e0e0", color = "#666666", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_sf(data = resight_points, color = "#2c7bb6", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_sf(data = resight_lines, aes(color = resight_type),
              alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = resight_colors) +
      coord_sf(xlim = xlims, ylim = ylims, crs = 4326) +
      annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2) +
      annotation_north_arrow(location = "tl", which_north = "true",
                              style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering()) +
      labs(title = "Resighting Locations and Movements",
           subtitle = "Lines connect paired sightings (L/R treated separately)",
           color = "Resight Type") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
            legend.position = "right")
  } else {
    cat("No resight location data available for mapping\n")
  }
}
```
